title: Full-Stack Engineer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: Advance from solid fundamentals to professional‑grade full‑stack projects and job readiness. Emphasize best practices, scalability, and real‑world deployment.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Strengthen core web fundamentals and version control.

milestones.title: JavaScript & TypeScript Basics
milestones.outcome: Write clean, typed JavaScript for both client and server code.

tasks.title: Read ES6+ guide on MDN
tasks.description: Study let/const, arrow functions, async/await, and modules.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp ES6 challenges
tasks.description: Solve 10 interactive exercises to cement syntax.

tasks.title: Set up a TypeScript project with tsconfig
tasks.description: Initialize npm, install typescript, and configure strict mode.

tasks.title: Refactor a small script to TypeScript
tasks.description: Add type annotations and fix any compile errors.

tasks.title: Reflect on type errors you encountered
tasks.description: Write a short note on how static typing improved code safety.

milestones.title: HTML, CSS, and Accessibility
milestones.outcome: Create semantic, responsive pages that meet basic WCAG criteria.

tasks.title: Read MDN HTML semantics article
tasks.description: Learn proper use of header, nav, main, article, and footer tags.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp Responsive Web Design module
tasks.description: Build a landing page using flexbox and grid.

tasks.title: Audit the page with Lighthouse accessibility
tasks.description: Identify and fix at least three accessibility issues.

tasks.title: Add ARIA attributes to interactive elements
tasks.description: Implement role, aria‑label, and live region where needed.

tasks.title: Summarize key accessibility takeaways
tasks.description: Write a bullet list of the most important guidelines.

milestones.title: Git & Collaboration Basics
milestones.outcome: Use Git confidently for branching, pull requests, and code reviews.

tasks.title: Read Git Handbook chapter on branching
tasks.description: Understand feature branches, main protection, and merge strategies.

tasks.title: Create a repo on GitHub and push initial commit
tasks.description: Initialize README, .gitignore, and license.

tasks.title: Practice rebasing a feature branch
tasks.description: Simulate a conflict and resolve it.

tasks.title: Open a pull request and request a review
tasks.description: Add a concise description and follow contribution guidelines.

tasks.title: Write a short retrospective on the PR workflow
tasks.description: Note what went well and what could improve.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Master the primary frameworks, back‑end language, and data layer.

milestones.title: React (or Next.js) Mastery
milestones.outcome: Build scalable component hierarchies with hooks, context, and routing.

tasks.title: Follow official React tutorial
tasks.description: Complete the Tic‑Tac‑Toe app, focusing on state and effects.

tasks.title: Add TypeScript to the tutorial project
tasks.description: Convert .js files to .tsx and add proper props typing.

tasks.title: Implement React Router for multi‑page navigation
tasks.description: Create three pages with lazy‑loaded routes.

tasks.title: Build a custom hook for data fetching
tasks.description: Encapsulate fetch logic with loading/error states.

tasks.title: Review React docs on concurrent features
tasks.description: Summarize how Suspense and transitions improve UX.

milestones.title: Node.js (or Django) Back‑End
milestones.outcome: Create RESTful APIs with authentication, validation, and error handling.

tasks.title: Read Express.js guide on the official docs
tasks.description: Learn routing, middleware, and error handling.

tasks.title: Set up an Express project with TypeScript
tasks.description: Configure ts-node-dev and enable strict typing.

tasks.title: Implement JWT authentication
tasks.description: Create login, signup, and protected route endpoints.

tasks.title: Write unit tests with Jest for the auth routes
tasks.description: Achieve at least 80% coverage.

tasks.title: Connect with a backend community on Discord
tasks.description: Introduce yourself and ask a question about middleware.

milestones.title: SQL Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Design relational schemas, write queries, and optimize performance.

tasks.title: Read PostgreSQL tutorial on the official docs
tasks.description: Cover tables, constraints, and basic queries.

tasks.title: Model a simple e‑commerce schema in pgAdmin
tasks.description: Create tables for users, products, orders, and relations.

tasks.title: Write CRUD queries for the orders table
tasks.description: Include joins to fetch user and product details.

tasks.title: Add indexes and measure query speed
tasks.description: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to compare before/after.

tasks.title: Summarize three common SQL anti‑patterns
tasks.description: Write a brief note for future reference.

milestones.title: SaaS Billing App
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate end‑to‑end feature delivery with payments and role‑based UI.

tasks.title: Sketch user flows and data model
tasks.description: Create a simple diagram of subscription tiers, users, and invoices.

tasks.title: Bootstrap a Next.js app with TypeScript
tasks.description: Set up pages, layout, and Tailwind CSS.

tasks.title: Implement Stripe checkout backend
tasks.description: Create API routes that create payment intents.

tasks.title: Add role‑based routing in React
tasks.description: Show admin dashboard only to privileged users.

tasks.title: Deploy to Vercel and configure environment variables
tasks.description: Make the app publicly accessible with secure keys.

tasks.title: Write a 2‑page case study for your portfolio
tasks.description: Explain challenges, solutions, and tech stack.

milestones.title: Real‑Time Chat Application
milestones.outcome: Show competence with websockets, scaling, and UI responsiveness.

tasks.title: Design message schema and API contract
tasks.description: Define fields, validation rules, and real‑time events.

tasks.title: Create a Node server using Socket.io
tasks.description: Handle connection, rooms, and broadcast messages.

tasks.title: Build a React chat UI with optimistic updates
tasks.description: Display incoming messages instantly and handle errors.

tasks.title: Add PostgreSQL persistence for chat history
tasks.description: Store messages and load recent history on join.

tasks.title: Deploy backend on Render and front‑end on Netlify
tasks.description: Configure CORS and secure websockets.

tasks.title: Gather feedback from 3 peers and iterate
tasks.description: Collect usability notes and fix top three issues.

milestones.title: Product Clone (e.g., Todoist)
milestones.outcome: Illustrate ability to replicate a complex UI and sync data across devices.

tasks.title: Map core features and required APIs
tasks.description: List tasks, projects, tags, and sync endpoints.

tasks.title: Set up a monorepo with Yarn workspaces
tasks.description: Separate client and server while sharing types.

tasks.title: Implement CRUD API with pagination
tasks.description: Use Express, TypeORM, and PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Create a responsive React UI with drag‑and‑drop
tasks.description: Use react-beautiful-dnd for task ordering.

tasks.title: Add offline support with Service Workers
tasks.description: Cache assets and sync changes when back online.

tasks.title: Publish the project on GitHub with a polished README
tasks.description: Include demo video, setup steps, and tech stack.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, professional habits, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: Deployment & DevOps Basics
milestones.outcome: Automate builds, monitor health, and roll back safely.

tasks.title: Read Docker getting‑started guide
tasks.description: Learn to containerize a Node app.

tasks.title: Write a Dockerfile and docker‑compose for the SaaS app
tasks.description: Include DB, backend, and front‑end services.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions CI pipeline
tasks.description: Run lint, test, and build on each push.

tasks.title: Configure health checks and basic logging on Render
tasks.description: Enable alerts for downtime.

tasks.title: Document the deployment process in the repo wiki
tasks.description: Create step‑by‑step instructions for future developers.

milestones.title: System Design Basics
milestones.outcome: Explain trade‑offs of common architectures and scalability patterns.

tasks.title: Read System Design Primer on GitHub
tasks.description: Cover load balancing, caching, and database sharding.

tasks.title: Sketch a high‑level diagram for the real‑time chat app
tasks.description: Identify components, data flow, and bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Calculate approximate RPS and storage needs for 10k users
tasks.description: Use simple formulas to estimate scaling requirements.

tasks.title: Discuss your design with a mentor on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Get feedback on missing considerations.

tasks.title: Write a 1‑page design summary for your portfolio
tasks.description: Highlight decisions, trade‑offs, and future improvements.

milestones.title: Job‑Ready Portfolio & Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Present a compelling portfolio and answer technical questions confidently.

tasks.title: Curate three projects on a personal website
tasks.description: Add live demos, source links, and concise descriptions.

tasks.title: Write STAR stories for each major project
tasks.description: Focus on impact, challenges, and results.

tasks.title: Practice whiteboard algorithms on LeetCode Easy/Medium
tasks.description: Complete 5 problems daily for two weeks.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer using Pramp
tasks.description: Get real‑time feedback on communication and coding.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with new headline and project highlights
tasks.description: Add keywords from the target role.
